facts.claim: A large-model finding: Shumailov and colleagues (Nature, 2024) trained models on recursively generated data and found the tails of the original distribution disappear. They call it model collapse.
A large-model finding: Gerstgrasser and colleagues (2024) found that replacing real data with each generation’s output leads to collapse, while accumulating it alongside the real data avoids it.
Self-Instruct (Wang and colleagues, 2022) had GPT-3 write its own instructions, filtered out invalid or similar ones, and tuned on the rest: a 33% absolute gain on Super-NaturalInstructions.
phi-1 (Gunasekar and colleagues, 2023), 1.3B parameters, trained on 6B tokens of filtered web text and 1B tokens of GPT-3.5-written textbooks, scored 50.6% on HumanEval.
